Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

 ⭐ Our Mobile Engineering team

There are ~40 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 400 engineers out of roughly 4,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. 

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

What You’ll Do 

  • Design and automate controls, detection mechanisms, and tooling to improve the Information Security of Algolia’s infrastructure and products 
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend new Information Security technologies, techniques, and frameworks 
  • Design, implement, and maintain information security monitoring and remediation systems that move the needle in protecting Algolia’s customers’ data, and protecting Algolia’s systems and data 
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to integrate Information Security into new features, systems, and development pipelines

  • Experience in incident detection, response, and vulnerability management 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain Information Security risks and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Full professional proficiency in English 

Nice to Have

The Team:

 You'll join the Data & Transformation (DAT) team, part of the Strategic Intelligence & Business Partner pillar. DAT is responsible for elevating data-driven decision-making across Finance and our go-to-market functions. This is an engineering role embedded close to the business: you'll write real code and build data products, but you'll also sit with the stakeholders you serve. We're raising the technical and analytical bar of the function — moving from descriptive reporting toward predictive, prescriptive, and AI-augmented insights — and we want people who help push that standard higher.

The Role:

We're looking for a highly analytical Analytics Engineer to strengthen how the team turns financial and operational data into insight. Working alongside senior analysts and business partners, you will build models, analyses, and automated data products that support smarter decisions and better performance across Finance, adoption, and GTM operations. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone who is genuinely strong with data — SQL, Python, and statistical thinking — who writes clean code, and who enjoys being close to the business and setting a higher standard of analytical and technical best practices.

The work you’ll do:

Analytics & Business Support

You'll partner with stakeholders across Finance and GTM operations to translate business questions into structured analyses and clear, well-reasoned recommendations. Data Products, Automation & AI

You'll build scalable, automated dashboards and data products that improve the speed and accuracy of insight, helping move the team from manual reporting toward automated, self-service analytics. You'll write clean, reproducible, version-controlled code (SQL and Python), help improve and maintain existing analytics, and make use of modern AI and agentic tooling — LLM-based assistants and coding copilots (e.g. Cursor), AI agents, and workflow automation — to accelerate work and reduce manual effort. You'll also help maintain data quality, consistency, and governance across datasets.

Cross-functional Collaboration

You'll work closely with Finance, adoption, and GTM operations, as well as Data/Tech teams, to identify analytics opportunities and embed data-driven thinking into core business processes — acting as a connection point between the business and the data.

The qualifications you need:

  • 2–4 years of experience in analytics engineering, data/business analytics, BI development, or a comparable technical and analytical role
  • Strong SQL skills and confidence working with large, complex datasets
  • Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, automation, and statistical/predictive modeling — a core part of the role
  • Solid foundations in data modeling and/or financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario planning
  • Working knowledge of statistical methods and an analytical mindset grounded in sound methodology and attention to detail
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (version control, testing, documentation) and BI / data visualization tools
  • Ability to translate data into clear insights and commun

The Team:

At Celonis Academy, we design and deliver self-paced online training and instructor-led training to a community of more than 200.000 learners around the world. These learners are predominantly Celonis customers and partners. Throughout everything we do, we always strive for excellence for our learners and we are the very proud winners of two 2025 Brandon Hall Gold Awards!

The Role:

With many thousands of learners worldwide consuming the content Celonis Academy creates, we rely on localization experts to identify localization needs and translate courses and exams for our partners and customers. We hope you’ll join us as one of these localization experts, translating content into Korean. This work accelerates the reach of our training and thus the impact of our product into Korean speaking markets. 
As a localization expert, you will work with various subject matter experts to create and translate highly interactive online training content on a large variety of topics. In the process of translation, you will ensure that localized training is adapted to specific cultures and user preferences. Through our feedback channel, you will see the direct impact of your work and will analyze qualitative and quantitative data to continually improve the courses.
You will be part of the Celonis Academy team and report to the Team Lead - Online training.

The work you’ll do:

  • Translate Celonis Academy training materials, such as courses, hands-on exercises and exams, from English to the target language Korean.
  • Review and post-edit machine-translated training materials
  • Perform linguistic quality and functionality checks based on the feedback from the learners
  • Maintain and update language-specific tools such as translation memory, glossary, and other relevant documentation
  • Provide input and feedback for the continuous improvement of translation processes

The qualifications you need:

  • Native-speaker level of proficiency in English and Korean

postings.title: Research Scientist (x/f/m)
postings.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Doctolab team (Doctolib Clinical AI Research Lab).

Your mission is to build accurate, well-calibrated, and clinically reliable models of patient health, learned from health data at scale. The work is both fundamental and applied: you publish, and your models reach products used by doctors and patients. Doctolib is used by around 450,000 health professionals and 90 million people across Europe, and research that succeeds in the lab can be deployed at that scale.

Working at Doctolib means contributing to one of Europe's leading health-tech companies, and seeing your work improve care for patients and practitioners.

How we work

Doctolab is a research lab in its founding phase, so researchers have real influence over its direction and its priorities. We work closely with the data science and product teams, and we stay close to the data.

We expect researchers to explain why a question matters, not only why it is open. Projects are chosen on both scientific ambition and what they change for patients and practitioners. The work suits researchers who want to see their results used.

The questions we raise are open problems in machine learning: world models that predict the consequences of an action, calibration and uncertainty, causal inference from observational data, multimodal sequence modelling, orchestration between model capabilities. Results on these questions hold well beyond healthcare. We are in a strong position to work on them: we have the data to learn a world model from, a clinical use case that defines success, and the engineering path to put it in front of practitioners and patients and learn from what comes back.

Experience with healthcare or medical data is a plus but not required. Both early-career and experienced researchers are welcome.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build a world model of patient health: how a health state evolves over time and changes in response to care, learned from observational data with the confounding accounted for
  • Build evaluation methods that test calibration, robustness, interpretability, privacy, and generalization outside the training distribution
  • Work with the data science and product teams to turn research results into clinical-grade features
  • Publish at leading machine learning and health informatics venues
  • Engage the international health and machine learning community through open collaboration: data challenges, shared benchmarks, and open-source releases
  • Help define the lab's research agenda and its working relationship with the rest of the company

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have a PhD in machine learning, statistics, computer science, or a related field, or a Master's degree with significant research experience
  • Have depth in one or more of: representation learning and self-supervised learning; large language models and multimodal modelling; causal inference and causal discovery from observational data; temporal and dynamic modelling; calibration and uncertainty quantification; agentic systems and orchestration; evaluation and benchmarking; privacy auditing of machine learning models
  • Have first-author publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or comparable medical informatics venues
  • Have driven your own research, from choosing the question to publishing the result
  • Are proficient in Python and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch, and have trained models yourself
  • Are comfortable working with large and imperfect real-world data
  • Can explain why a research question matters, scientifically and for patients or practitioners
  • Are fluent in English, the working language of the lab

Workday Analytics & Reporting

  • Own the integration architecture: APIs, middleware connectors, Workday Studio, Cloud Connect, and Boomi in collaboration with the Delivery Factory
  • Ensure integration monitoring, incident management, and quality standards across the data layer
  • Key contributor to the PeopleData Hub architecture — coordinating closely with business stakeholders and the Doctolib Data team — to design the central data flow layer connecting HR systems to downstream consumers (Finance, BI, Payroll)

  • Explore and prototype Workday AI Agents capabilities for HR process automation (self-service, proactive insights, L1 deflection , extension with WD Extend capabilities)

  • Build runbooks and integration playbooks that enable autonomous operation and handover to operational teams
  • Act as the go-to expert on integration patterns within PSP

Who you are

You could be our next teammate if you have:

  • 6+ years of Workday experience, including hands-on Workday reporting and at least one full integration implementation
  • Proven integration architecture experience: Workday Studio, Cloud Connect, APIs (REST/SOAP), or equivalent middleware
  • Experience with HR data flows: payroll integrations (ADP, Deel), benefits/LMS connectors
  • Strong data modeling and governance mindset — you understand the HR data model and its downstream impacts
  • Exposure to AI tooling in an HR context (Workday AI Agents, chatbots, agentic workflows, DUST, or similar)
  • Functional expertise in at least one Workday module: Compensation & Advanced Compensation, or Absence & Time Tracking 
  • Ability to work autonomously in a lean team with direct ownership and minimal process overhead

postings.description:
About us

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

 

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights. 

  • Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
  • Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
  • Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
  • Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
  • Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)

 

What Excites You

  • Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features. 
  • Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
  • Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
  • Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across the business.
  • Unlocking new layers of payment performance, from uncovering new fraud vectors to maximizing success rates
  • Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.

Engineering at GoCardless 

The technical challenges of building GoCardless span from simplifying building banking schemes to optimising the time to render the dashboard. 

You will enjoy being a software engineer at GoCardless if:

  • You’re looking to champion a great engineering culture within GC and in the wider engineering community; 
  • You enjoy collaborating and learning from people from various backgrounds and experiences; 
  • You want to feel proud of the work you’re doing and its impact on real customers.

Our engineers contribute to the engineering culture within and outside of GoCardless: they contribute to Open Source Software projects (see our Github), and share learnings in post-mortems, conferences and on our blog.

About Payer Proposition

We are a small, mighty and growing team that is responsible for developing GoCardless’ payer proposition, where we want to build and generate value from payer networks. 

GoCardless is used by tens of millions of payers each year, but so far we have done little to engage and build a relationship with them. Most still use our services without knowing. 

We want GoCardless to become the easiest, and most rewarding way for payers to pay. In turn we want to use the relationship we build with our payers to enhance our service for our merchants. This means you’ll be exploring areas as varied as whether we can improve our paying experience, to whether we should offer rewards and incentives for paying with GoCardless. 

This is a greenfield area for GoCardless, and will involve a high level of ambiguity, experimentation and cross-functional collaboration as we go on this journey to make GoCardless the easiest and most preferred way to pay.

postings.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance
  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it
  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well
  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

Lead the Hub Model

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

postings.title: Compliance and Prevention Associate (Complaints Management)

postings.description:
About the opportunity

 

N26 is looking for a Head of Product - Core Banking Systems to partner with our Engineering, Treasury, Risk, and Banking Operations teams. In this role, you will own the Core Banking Systems product roadmap and lead a team of product & business managers delivering foundational capabilities that power N26 — from rapid product configuration to balance sheet infrastructure and regulatory reporting.

You will work at the intersection of Core Banking architecture, financial data integrity, and compliance on one side, and real-world banking and product challenges on the other. Your mission is to transform Core Banking Systems from a cost center into a composable platform that enables product managers to configure and launch products in days, embeds compliance by design, and lays the foundation for growth beyond N26. You will be the connective tissue between technical platform excellence and business outcomes, ensuring that our core engine powers flawless banking across N26 and eventually external financial institutions.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Own and drive the Core Systems product roadmap across Product Enablement (lending, deposits, payments gateway) and Balance Sheet Infrastructure (financial data products, treasury, books & accounting), balancing near-term execution with long-term strategic horizons.

  • Partner closely with N26 Product Segments and functional stakeholders across Treasury, Credit Risk, Risk Controlling, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting on priorities, planning cycles, and shared OKRs.

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Core Banking initiatives — from self-service product enablement and third-party vendor in-housing through migration, platform scalability, and iteration.

  • Define and roll out core platform best practices across the organization — including product configuration standards (Product Factory), ledger data integrity, evaluation frameworks, and progressive rollout guardrails.

  • Contribute to N26's company-wide strategy to establish single sources of truth for financial data, eliminate core vendor dependencies, and reduce risk concentration across endpoints.

  • Support domain optimization by transitioning stable, non-core services to appropriate segment owners while maintaining operational excellence and zero material audit findings.

  • Manage and develop a team of Core Systems Product Managers, fostering a culture of operational rigor, precision, and platform enablement.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to other Product & Tech teams looking to integrate with core banking engines, sharing best practices and enabling rapid go-to-market execution.

  • Manage stakeholder communication across Product, Engineering, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.

  • Define and track domain KPIs that measure product enablement speed, system uptime, compliance metrics, OPEX cost savings, and balance sheet data integrity.

 

What you need to be successful:

 

  • 5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on core banking systems, ledger infrastructure, payments, or core platform products.

  • Proven experience partnering with Core Banking and Platform Engineering experts — you understand how transaction processing, ledgers, and accounting engines work and know how to build scalable platform products.

  • Strong technical literacy — you understand backend platform trade-offs, core endpoint dynamics, multi-currency ledgers, and data pipelines, allowing you to engage credibly with engineering teams.

  • Agile practitioner — experience managing multiple mission-critical workstreams in fast-paced, high-availability environments.

  • Excellent communication skills — the ability to translate complex technical and financial concepts for non-technical audiences and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.

postings.title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Balance Management
postings.description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. 

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp’s core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You’ll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You’re comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • You’re eager to learn about relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It’s a plus if you have

  • Knowledge of Elixir - some of our legacy services are written in Elixir, and while it's not essential, it would be useful if you've worked with it before
  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
  • A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pens

postings.title: Backend Engineer- Global Bank
postings.description:
In the Global Bank tribe, we are building the infrastructure and core services needed to provide our merchants with a digital bank account that empowers them to be successful at doing what they love. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally by offering a high-quality banking experience tailored to their needs - effortless, simple, and affordable.

Joining the Global Bank tribe means playing a key role in helping us build SumUp's digital bank. You’ll collaborate with a global, autonomous, cross-functional team that refines an aspect of our product from concept to execution. Work alongside colleagues from 32 nationalities across Cologne, Berlin, São Paulo, Sofia, London and Vilnius, united by a shared commitment to taking ownership, working with purpose, and helping small businesses thrive.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll be responsible for evolving and maintaining a high-throughput banking ecosystem for merchants inside our Global Bank Tribe. You’ll play a key role in architecting and evolving our global banking platform; ensuring high availability, scalability, and observability across multiple regions. If you'd like to gain experience building business accounts, card payment, and transfers products etc, across Europe and Latam for SumUp's Global Bank, join us and be part of this exciting journey!

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with a global team to design and build a unified global banking platform. This includes high-level APIs for multiple regions and local implementations, ensuring high availability and observability
  • Be part of the transformation team that is transforming monolithic services into decoupled, highly scalable, region-agnostic, unified global bank services
  • Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services, while continuously evaluating and implementing new methods to ensure the high reliability of transfer systems
  • Maintain and improve core services utilizing a modern, cloud-native technology stack (AWS, K8s), with microservices written in Golang, Kotlin and Java and Elixir.
  • Improve test coverage for existing services and drive the end-to-end delivery of changes, including testing, observability, and monitoring.
  • Shape and continuously improve our engineering culture by sharing ideas, refining best practices, exploring innovative solutions, and contributing to comprehensive documentation and tool selection.

You’ll be great for this role if 

  • Solid programming experience and interest in working in any of these modern languages (Java, Kotlin, Golang and Elixir).
  • You have advanced understanding of developing and maintaining distributed and event-driven systems.
  • You have solid experience with event streaming platforms and messaging brokers such as Kafka
  • You have experience with modern cloud technologies like AWS, and containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • You feel comfortable working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • You are experienced with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions or ArgoCD
  • You take pride in your work, have a keen sense of ownership, and are dedicated to writing clear, maintainable, and testable code.
  • Your curiosity and enthusiasm for solving meaningful challenges for users and a commitment to collaboration and continuous learning.
  • You are comfortable pairing with your peers on a day-to-day basis, sharing knowledge and learning from each other, fostering the culture of knowledge sharing 

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • The opportunity to work on large scale fintech products used by millions of businesses around the world
  • You’ll receive 25 days’ paid leave, plus 1 additional day for each year of employment.
  • You can take up to 10 days’ educational leave to expand your skill set.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success
  • Access to the SumUp Sabbatical, our Employee assistance program for mental health
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women

postings.title: Chief Operating Officer (PCF-42) - SumUp Limited
postings.description:
SumUp Limited is our Central Bank of Ireland regulated electronic money institution, and it's entering a defining period of its growth. As Chief Operating Officer, you'll take overall accountability for the firm's internal operations, working alongside the SumUp executive team to make sure our governance, resilience, and regulatory standards match the scale of what we're building. This is a rare chance to shape the operating backbone of a regulated fintech from a senior, board level seat, at a moment when the firm is actively strengthening its structure and controls to support future growth.

What you'll do

  • Set and deliver SumUp Limited's operational strategy in partnership with the senior leadership team
  • Own the firm's outsourcing strategy, including governance, oversight, risk assessment, and the outsourcing register
  • Maintain regulatory accountability documents, including the Statement of Responsibilities and the Management Responsibility Map under SEAR
  • Act as a senior point of contact for the Central Bank of Ireland, supporting inspections and regulatory engagement
  • Own operational resilience, business continuity, and wind down planning, including testing and incident response
  • Provide regular operational reporting to the CEO, board, and Central Bank of Ireland on performance, risk, and compliance

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Significant senior leadership experience in an operations role within a Central Bank of Ireland regulated financial services firm or e-money institution
  • Strong working knowledge of the Individual Accountability Framework, SEAR, and Fitness and Probity requirements, gained through holding or supporting a PCF role
  • Track record of managing large, complex operational organisations across multiple markets
  • Experience owning outsourcing governance, operational resilience frameworks, and regulatory compliance programmes
  • Ability to deliver operational transformation and efficiency at scale while managing regulator relationships credibly and transparently

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our homely, Dublin hub just steps from Harcourt Street Luas and charming Iveagh Gardens. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: 25 days paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

🏥 Well-being support: health insurance for you and your family, and subsidised gym membership when you stay active

🚲 Easy commute perks: participate in the Bike-to-Work or TaxSaver Commuter Ticket scheme

💼 Financial growth: retirement savings match—SumUp tops your contributions up to 5%

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. postings.title: Consultor de Ventas - Autonomo
postings.description:
Consultor de Ventas

Sobre nosotros

Los grandes vendedores no esperan oportunidades, las crean.

Buscamos perfiles orientados a resultados, con mentalidad comercial fuerte y ganas de construir algo propio mientras ayudan a los pequeños negocios a crecer.

Las pymes y comercios en España son la base de nuestra economía y necesitan una plataforma de pagos y gestión financiera diseñada para su realidad. Eso es exactamente lo que ofrece SumUp, y estamos ampliando nuestro equipo comercial para llegar a negocios en todo el país.

Descripción del rol

Buscamos un Consultor de Ventas para desarrollar negocio en tu territorio asignado.

Estarás en contacto directo con propietarios de pequeños y medianos negocios, ayudándoles a descubrir cómo las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp pueden mejorar su operativa diaria.

Este es un rol para personas que disfrutan vendiendo cara a cara, generando sus propias oportunidades y construyendo relaciones comerciales sólidas.

Desde el primer día tendrás autonomía para desarrollar tu mercado, construir tu pipeline y cerrar acuerdos.

Qué harás

  • Identificar y captar nuevos clientes, especialmente pequeños y medianos negocios.

  • Generar oportunidades comerciales mediante prospección, networking y puerta fría.

  • Realizar reuniones presenciales y demostraciones de producto.

  • Explicar el valor de las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp.

  • Construir y gestionar tu propio pipeline comercial.

  • Gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de forma efectiva.

  • Crear relaciones de confianza a largo plazo con los comercios de tu cartera.

  • Alcanzar y superar objetivos comerciales de forma constante.

Encajarás si...

  • Tienes experiencia en ventas B2B, Field Sales o desarrollo de negocio.

  • Has trabajado generando tus propias oportunidades comerciales.

  • Tienes experiencia en prospección, generación de leads y construcción de pipeline.

  • Estás acostumbrado a trabajar por objetivos.

  • Conoces bien el tejido empresarial local y los retos de los pequeños negocios.

  • Te sientes cómodo vendiendo cara a cara y desarrollando relaciones comerciales.

  • Eres autónomo, resiliente y orientado a resultados.

Por qué unirte a SumUp

  • Bonus mensual de 500€ sujeto a Partner Status.

  • 50% de los ingresos generados por pagos, hardware y software.

  • 20% de ingreso recurrente sobre tu cartera durante dos años.

  • Potencial de generar ingresos recurrentes a largo plazo.

  • Formación práctica en producto, ventas y desarrollo comercial.

  • Acompañamiento continuo por parte de un Territory Manager.

  • Libertad para gestionar tu territorio y desarrollar tu propio negocio.

Diversidad e inclusión

En SumUp creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación. Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos a todas las personas independientemente de su origen, género, identidad de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

SumUp no acepta currículums no solicitados de agencias externas. Las candidaturas deben enviarse directamente por los propios candidatos.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

postings.title: Consultor de Ventas Autonom
postings.description:
Consultor de Ventas

Sobre nosotros

Los grandes vendedores no esperan oportunidades, las crean.

Buscamos perfiles orientados a resultados, enfocados en generar negocio y con ganas de construir algo propio mientras ayudan a los pequeños negocios a crecer.

Las pymes y comercios en España son la base de nuestra economía y necesitan una plataforma de pagos y gestión financiera diseñada para su realidad. Eso es exactamente lo que ofrece SumUp, y estamos ampliando nuestro equipo comercial para llegar a negocios en todo el país.

Descripción del rol

Buscamos un Consultor de Ventas para desarrollar negocio dentro de tu territorio asignado.

En este rol estarás en la calle cada día, construyendo relaciones reales con propietarios de negocios locales y mostrándoles cómo las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp pueden mejorar la forma en que operan.

El pequeño comercio en España es dinámico, pero también competitivo. Los clientes esperan opciones de pago rápidas, flexibles y modernas. Los negocios necesitan algo más que un simple datáfono. Necesitan una solución integrada que les ayude a gestionar cobros, controlar ingresos y tomar decisiones con información en tiempo real.

Desde el primer día se espera que generes negocio, identifiques oportunidades, construyas tu propio pipeline y cierres acuerdos. Tendrás herramientas, producto y soporte, pero el empuje y la disciplina deben venir de ti.

Si te motivan los objetivos, disfrutas vendiendo cara a cara y quieres tener un impacto real ayudando al comercio local, queremos conocerte.

Qué harás

  • Identificar y captar nuevos clientes, especialmente pequeños y medianos negocios.

As part of the Platform tribe, you will help build a self-service, AI-Ready Data Platform. The Data Platform team supports our next big bets: Data, AI, and real-time analytics. We are a team focused on building scalable, reliable infrastructure to enable our global data community.

postings.title: FP&A  Strategy Intern
postings.description:
FP&A Strategy Intern — Corporate FP&A

Berlin, Germany (office-first)

About the team

Corporate FP&A is SumUp's internal strategy and finance partner to business leaders— the team that turns data into the decisions that move the business. We build the forecasts, scenario models, and business cases behind capital allocation, reporting strategy, and investor relations. Think of us as an in-house consulting team with a finance lens. As our FP&A Strategy Intern, you'll own real analyses from day one and see your work shape decisions at the leadership level.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain financial and strategic models to evaluate capital allocation trade-offs, market-entry scenarios, and long-range business plans
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on internal data to surface risks, opportunities, and strategic insights that inform executive decision-making
  • Drive cross-functional strategy projects — pricing optimisation, revenue growth levers, unit-economics improvement, or cost-efficiency initiatives — and present recommendations to senior leadership
  • Develop investment cases and business cases for product launches, geographic expansion, and strategic initiatives, translating complex analysis into clear narratives for board-level reporting
  • Design and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and performance frameworks, and contribute to the automation of analytical workflows using modern tools and scripting

You'll be a great fit if…

  • You completed (or you're about to complete) a Master's degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a quantitative field from a top-tier university
  • You think in a structured, hypothesis-driven way — you can take an ambiguous strategic question, break it into a clear issue tree, and drive to a data-backed recommendation
  • You've had a first taste of high-impact problem-solving through internships in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, venture capital, growth-stage startups, or investment banking
  • You're a strong analytical modeller — confident building scenario analyses and sensitivity models in Google Sheets or Excel, and you can (or want to learn to) automate workflows with Apps Script or Python
  • You can tell a crisp, visual story in slides — distilling complex analysis into clear, executive-ready narratives in Google Slides or PowerPoint
  • You have solid financial acumen — you understand P&L drivers, unit economics, and how business performance flows through the numbers

Why you should join SumUp

  • Work on real strategic questions alongside SumUp's finance leadership — your analysis will feed decisions affecting 4 million+ merchants across 37 markets
  • A steep learning curve with direct mentorship from senior FP&A managers who've come from consulting and banking backgrounds
  • A role that blends strategy, finance, and data — the kind of experience that accelerates careers in corporate strategy, investing, or operating roles
  • Extras like an Urban Sports Club subsidy and subsidised office lunches
  • A truly global, multicultural team of 3,000+ SumUppers from 90+ nationalities

About SumUp

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe with simple, affordable tools that help them thrive. Over 4 million businesses across 37 markets rely on SumUp to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships. postings.title: Full Stack Engineer - Billings & Subscriptions
postings.description:
Our Billing and Subscriptions team sits at the heart of how SumUp's merchants pay for, manage, and grow with our products. We own the billing engine, merchant wallet, and subscription experiences that underpin millions of transactions across 37 markets, and right now, we're in an exciting phase of rebuilding and expanding that foundation. We're deepening our billing capabilities to support new sales models, market expansions, and financial integrations that directly shape how small businesses experience SumUp — and this role is central to making that happen.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain backend services and frontend interfaces across our billing, contracts, and merchant wallet products
  • Contribute to the refactoring of key billing components to improve reliability, data security, and alignment with our wider payments platform
  • Support the expansion of our billing and wallet capabilities into new markets, helping ensure localisation requirements are met
  • Take part in our weekly support rotation, handling incoming customer queries and helping maintain platform stability
  • Work closely with senior engineers and product managers to deliver features end-to-end, from implementation through to production

You'll be great for this role if

  • Solid experience building full stack applications, with a backend focus. Ideally comfortable with Node.js or Go, though we're open to other backend languages.
  • Comfortable working with both relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and non-relational databases (such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Redis).
  • Practical frontend experience working with React and Next.js, with the ability to write clean, typed code in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to give and receive clear, constructive feedback.
  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving, able to make sensible trade-offs, unblock yourself and others, and write clean, maintainable code.

Why you should join SumUp

postings.description:
SumUp gives small businesses the tools they need to get paid, manage their money, and grow - today, over 4 million merchants across 37 markets worldwide rely on SumUp to do exactly that.

The Bank Web squad sits within SumUp's Banking domain and owns the web experience across our banking surfaces - from the business account dashboard that merchants use daily, to the back-office tooling that powers the support teams behind them. The team has a clear mission: make Bank Web a genuinely first-class platform, on par with our mobile applications in quality, reliability, and performance.

Joining now means being part of a team that’s at a key growth point - modernization work, growing scope across markets, and making architectural decisions that will shape how millions of merchants experience SumUp's banking products.

👉 Take a look at our Sofia office

  • Build and own features end-to-end across our web banking surfaces - from scoping and component implementation through testing, observability, and production maintenance
  • Work across the full stack - including defining API contracts, working with backend proxies, and integrating with the services that power our banking platform
  • Contribute to modernisation efforts, including architectural improvements, component refactoring, and stack migrations that reduce technical debt and accelerate future delivery

postings.description:
Head of AML and CTF (PCF 52)

About the team

SumUp's global AML Governance team sits at the heart of how we protect our business, our customers, and the small businesses we serve every day. As SumUp grows into new markets and builds out a truly global compliance structure, this team is expanding its reach,  moving from a European focus to a worldwide one, covering regulated entities across the UK, Ireland, Lithuania, Brazil, Chile, Italy, and Australia.

This is a critical, regulated role (PCF-52) for SumUp Limited, our Irish entity. You'll be the primary point of contact with the Central Bank of Ireland and Irish law enforcement on all financial crime matters, and you'll hold overall responsibility for maintaining the framework for detection, prevention, and reporting of financial crime across our Irish operations. This is a real opportunity to shape how AML / CTF governance works at scale across SumUp's regulated entities.

👉 Take a look at our Dublin office

What you'll do

  • Own and maintain SumUp Limited's AML / CTF framework, ensuring full compliance with Irish regulatory requirements and managing all communications with the Central Bank of Ireland
  • Act as the primary contact for Financial Intelligence Units and law enforcement agencies on financial crime matters, including overseeing SAR decisions and escalations
  • Deliver clear, data-driven reporting to the PIL Board and senior management on financial crime risks, regulatory developments, and the effectiveness of the compliance framework.
  • Strengthen financial crime awareness across the business through targeted training and stakeholder engagement, while leading annual AML/CTF risk assessments and overseeing transaction monitoring, screening, and reporting programmes.
  • Contribute to the development of the global KYC framework alongside the Head of KYC Strategy and the wider MLRO community
  • Build strong relationships with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to embed a practical, risk-aware compliance culture across the business

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Prior experience as a Head of AML or MLRO within the Irish financial services sector, ideally in fintech, payments, or e-money, and eligibility for PCF-52 approval.
  • Deep knowledge of Irish AML/CTF regulations, CBI guidance, and law enforcement reporting frameworks, with the confidence to engage regulators directly.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and validating comprehensive AML/CTF and sanctions compliance frameworks, supported by strong capabilities in financial crime risk assurance and regulatory reporting.
  • Skilled at maintaining robust regulatory standards while supporting business growth, applying proportionate controls that manage risk without creating unnecessary operational barriers.
  • Strong analytical judgement to identify emerging financial crime typologies and ability to translate complex financial crime risks into clear, practical measures that support business growth without compromising compliance.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, scale-up environment where navigating ambiguity and building cross-functional relationships are part of the day-to-day.

postings.title: Head of Consumer Growth
postings.description:
Head of Consumer Growth

SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.

More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world’s largest consumer financial ecosystems.

Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers and this role will lead that journey.

As Head of Consumer Growth, you will own the go-to-market strategy, commercial growth plan and acquisition engine for SumUp’s consumer product. You will build the consumer growth function from its current early stage, bringing together performance marketing, direct-to-consumer acquisition, merchant-led distribution, CRM, creative and content.

You will combine proven consumer growth channels with an opportunity unique to SumUp: turning our merchant network and consumer touchpoints into a powerful new route to market. From paid acquisition, referrals and lifecycle marketing to receipts, payment screens, merchant communications and in-store experiences, you will determine how SumUp reaches, converts and retains millions of consumers.

Our ambition goes beyond building another successful consumer finance product. By connecting consumers and merchants within the same ecosystem, we can change the economics of payments. The more consumers who choose to pay with SumUp, the closer we move towards our long-term ambition of eliminating transaction fees for businesses around the world.

What you’ll do

  • Own the go-to-market strategy and growth plan for SumUp’s consumer product across six European markets.
  • Build and lead a multidisciplinary consumer growth team spanning performance marketing, merchant-led acquisition, direct-to-consumer marketing, CRM, design and content.
  • Develop a balanced acquisition model that combines proven consumer growth channels with SumUp’s unique merchant network and consumer touchpoints.
  • Take commercial ownership of growth investment, including channel mix, acquisition cost, incentives, promotions, attribution and forecasting.
  • Establish a rigorous test-and-learn programme, turning successful experiments into repeatable playbooks that can scale across markets.
  • Own the consumer GTM roadmap, ensuring product launches, propositions and campaigns are coordinated across channels and markets.
  • Partner closely with Product, Brand, Communications and SumUp’s wider GTM organisation to sharpen the proposition, improve conversion and activate relevant channels across the business.
  • Represent consumer growth in leadership discussions, bringing clarity to performance, investment decisions and the trade-offs required to scale.

You’ll be great for this role if you have

  • A strong track record of leading full-funnel growth for a consumer fintech, neobank, financial services product or high-growth consumer app.
  • Experience scaling a consumer proposition across multiple markets and through a comparable stage of growth.
  • Deep expertise in acquisition strategy, channel mix, attribution, customer acquisition cost, lifecycle growth and unit economics.
  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary growth teams while remaining comfortable operating hands-on.
  • Strong commercial judgement and a track record of making effective investment decisions under uncertainty.
  • The ability to work across Product, Brand, Analytics, Communications and local market teams within a complex organisation.
  • A rigorous experimentation mindset and the ability to operate quickly and pragmatically in an early-stage environment.
  • Familiarity with financial services marketing regulations and the judgement to work within them without losing creativity or pace.

This is an opportunity to build more than a marketing team. You will create the growth model for a consumer financial product with the potential to operate at global scale, turn one of the world’s largest merchant networks into a powerful distribution channel, and help SumUp build a new payments ecosystem that works better for consumers and businesses around the world.

postings.description:
About the team:

The Mobile Platform Squad is the backbone of SumUp's iOS engineering — we build and maintain the foundation that every iOS feature team relies on to ship fast, confidently, and at scale.

We're a small, high-impact team that sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and engineering excellence. Our work isn't visible to merchants directly, but it's felt by every iOS engineer at SumUp every single day — through faster build times, smoother CI/CD pipelines, healthier codebases, and better tooling.

With significant investment in SumUp's mobile products, we're on a mission to empower feature teams to deliver world-class experiences without being slowed down by platform friction. That means building robust internal frameworks, evolving a mature and complex codebase, and acting as a trusted partner to mobile engineers across the organization.

Our engineering culture is built on autonomy, collaboration, and craft. We move with purpose, share knowledge openly, and believe that great platform work is what makes great product work possible. If you're someone who finds deep satisfaction in enabling others to do their best work — you'll feel right at home here.

 

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain internal tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that support the consistency, scalability, and long-term health of SumUp's iOS app
  • Contribute to CI/CD systems and developer tooling initiatives that help feature teams ship with speed and confidence
  • Tackle technical debt and codebase health improvements in a complex, mature codebase — with a focus on simplicity and maintainability
  • Collaborate closely with mobile engineers across squads, acting as a go-to partner for platform questions, reviews, and best practices
  • Take end-to-end ownership of well-scoped platform initiatives — from design and implementation through to delivery and documentation

 

You will be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Are experienced with or genuinely excited about CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Fastlane) and developer tooling — you see automation as a superpower

postings.title: Responsable de secteur - Paris
postings.description:
Nous recrutons : Responsable de secteur - Paris

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les petites entreprises à se développer, du café de quartier à Lille jusqu'à la boutique indépendante à Milan. Notre mission est simple : permettre aux entrepreneurs de réussir grâce à des solutions financières puissantes et faciles à utiliser.

Nous recherchons actuellement des Responsable de secteur à Paris, prêts à développer leur secteur, montrer l'exemple et évoluer rapidement vers un poste de Responsable régional(e)
Vos missions

Développer les ventes terrain
  • Acquérir de nouveaux commerçants dans la région de Paris en commercialisant les solutions d'encaissement (POS) et les terminaux de paiement SumUp en face à face.
Piloter votre secteur
  • Gérer et développer votre zone géographique en identifiant les opportunités de croissance et en accélérant l'acquisition de nouveaux commerçants.
Accompagner une équipe
  • Recruter, former et accompagner une équipe de commerciaux terrain en CDI.
Contribuer à la stratégie locale
  • Faire remonter les retours du terrain afin d'améliorer notre stratégie commerciale et tester de nouvelles initiatives générant un réel impact.
Le profil recherché
Vous vous épanouirez dans ce rôle si vous :
  • Disposez d'une expérience confirmée dans la vente terrain, idéalement dans les secteurs des solutions d'encaissement, du paiement, des télécommunications ou des technologies auprès des PME.
  • Avez déjà managé une équipe de commerciaux terrain en CDI.
  • Parlez couramment le français et l'anglais.
  • Êtes orienté résultats, aimez conclure des ventes et souhaitez évoluer vers des responsabilités managériales.
  • Connaissez bien votre marché local, ou êtes capable de vous l'approprier rapidement.
  • Une expérience dans la fintech, le SaaS ou les technologies destinées aux commerçants constitue un véritable atout.
Ce que nous proposons
  • Salaire fixe compétitif accompagné de commissions déplafonnées.
  • Parcours d'évolution accéléré vers un poste de Responsable régional(e).
  • Indemnité voiture.
  • Outils, CRM et formation complète pour favoriser votre réussite.
  • Autonomie et flexibilité sur le terrain.
  • L'opportunité de rejoindre une fintech internationale qui transforme le commerce de proximité.
Avantages (France)
  • Tickets restaurant.
  • Prise en charge à 50 % des transports en commun.
  • Participation de 50 % à la mutuelle.
  • Abonnement gratuit à Babbel Professional pour l'apprentissage des langues.
Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp ?
Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'un poste commercial : c'est une véritable opportunité d'accélérer votre carrière. Vous développerez votre propre secteur, contribuerez à renforcer notre présence sur un marché stratégique en France et évoluerez vers un poste de management au sein d'une entreprise qui réinvente les solutions de paiement pour les petites entreprises.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ?
Postulez dès maintenant et contribuez au développement des commerçants de Paris avec SumUp.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

postings.title: Workday Specialist
postings.description:
About the team:

At SumUp, we’re passionate about supporting small businesses. We believe everyone should have access to flexible, fair, and easy-to-use technology that helps bring their ideas to life. Every day, millions of people around the world dream of starting their own business—and we’re here to help make that happen. Our long-term ambition is to "close the loop" by turning everyday transactions into lasting relationships between businesses and their customers.

As part of our People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience.

In this role, reporting to the Head of People Tech, you’ll work at the heart of our Workday ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with People Operations, Payroll, and business stakeholders to ensure our Workday HCM setup remains scalable, reliable, and intuitive as we grow.

Rather than simply maintaining the system, you’ll help shape how our employee lifecycle processes are designed, configured, and continuously improved — ensuring Workday supports both operational excellence and a seamless experience for SumUppers.

What you'll do:

  • Configure and enhance Workday’s Core HCM module to ensure our processes are scalable, consistent, and easy to navigate.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into thoughtful system design — improving workflows, automation, and data quality.
  • Strengthen document generation, validation logic, and reporting structures to reduce manual work and prevent downstream errors.
  • Provide responsive and empathetic guidance to SumUppers using Workday, helping them feel confident and supported.
  • Build and maintain reliable reports and dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and supporting informed decision-making.
  • Contribute to clear documentation, structured change management, and sustainable configuration standards.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday HCM Core (experience with additional modules such as Time Tracking or Compensation is a plus).
  • A solid understanding of Workday fundamentals such as Staffing, Worker Data, Organizations, Business Processes, and Reporting.
  • Confidence working with structured datasets to validate configuration changes and ensure reliable outputs.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and attention to data accuracy.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
  • A mindset that looks for simplification, standardisation, and continuous improvement.
  • Advanced English communication skills; 
  • Intermediate Portuguese;

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🏙 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, and subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

postings.title: iOS Engineer - Platform
postings.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫

Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

 

The Challenge 🧩

You will join the iOS Platform team, the team that sets the technical direction for iOS at Wallapop. Our users are primarily other engineers, and our mission is to supercharge their daily productivity while defending the quality and performance of our app. We own the build system, developer tooling, module architecture, testing infrastructure, and observability foundations that everyone else ships on top of.

 

We work on a 10+ year-old codebase used by millions of people (~115 modules and over 20,000 Swift files), where every second shaved off a build is multiplied across the entire engineering chapter.

 

In this role, you will own app performance as a product metric—from launch time and responsiveness to memory footprint and app size. As an iOS Platform Engineer, you will have company-wide scope, acting as an architect, mentoring engineers across the chapter, and tackling our most complex technical challenges.

Our tech stack:

  • Build & Infra: Bazel-based build system with remote caching/execution, paired with Tente (our in-house Go CLI and BSP server to support IDEs like VSCode, Neovim).
  • CI/CD & Testing: High-scale pipelines on Bitrise, a robust testing pyramid featuring Quick/Nimble, ~9,000 snapshot references, and Maestro E2E flows in the cloud.
  • Architecture & UI: Simplified, TCA-inspired architecture built on RxSwift, custom dependency injection, UIKit, SwiftUI, and our Conchita design system.
  • Observability & AI: Deep tracing via Sentry and OpenTelemetry, automated PR quality gates, and AI-assisted workflows (AI code-review bot and repo-native agents).

 

What You Will Do 👇

  • Keep builds fast, hermetic, and understandable as the codebase and the team grow.
  • Build developer tooling that engineers actually enjoy using, and measure whether it moves the needle on daily productivity.
  • Maintain a healthy, fast, and trustworthy CI/CD and release pipeline, from PR checks to the App Store.
  • Define, measure, and deliver on user-facing performance goals: app launch time, responsiveness, rendering smoothness, memory footprint, and crash-free rate.
  • Profile with Instruments on real devices and optimize at the binary level (main-thread startup work, dyld and static initializers, binary layout, and framework count).
  • Own the observability stack (Sentry/OpenTelemetry) to provide tracing and dashboards that engineers trust, and set up automated guardrails in CI to block regressions.
  • Set the module boundaries and structural design of the app, leading migrations that cross a hundred modules without freezing feature delivery.
  • Design and lead our structural architectural evolution, including the transition from RxSwift toward modern Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors, Sendable).
  • Partner with feature teams as an enabler: unblock them, document the paths, and make "the right thing the easy thing" to do.
  • Drive technical decisions with chapter-wi

postings.title: MLOps Engineer
postings.description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫

Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.

 

The Challenge 🧩

Wallapop generates billions of data points daily. With a mature data infrastructure already in place, our Data Science and Machine Learning area is gaining significant momentum. As we scale, we face the exciting challenge of taking our ML Platform to the next level to support complex solutions in Personalization, Search, Trust & Safety, and Logistics. As an ML Engineer (MLOps), you will contribute to the evolution of our ML Platform and MLOps practice. You will partner with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and DevOps to collaborate on a vision that balances innovation with reliability, ensuring our models scale efficiently to serve millions of users.

 

What You Will Do 👇

  • Iterate and maintain Wallapop’s ML Platform, identifying opportunities to improve speed, reliability, and maintainability. You will help execute the long-term vision and roadmap for MLOps.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Data Scientists to support their efforts, ensuring they have the tooling to develop, deploy, and monitor scalable models efficiently.

  • Adopt and promote engineering best practices (coding standards, testing, CI/CD) within the ML domain.

  • Partner with Data Engineering and DevOps to align ML development with company-wide infrastructure and data governance standards.

  • Investigate and integrate new frameworks and tools (e.g., for LLMs or real-time inference) to keep our stack modern and effective.

 

What We’re Looking For 🔎

  • Solid experience contributing to and maintaining production-ready ML platforms and pipelines. You understand the lifecycle from experimentation to monitoring.

  • Solid understanding of AWS components (SageMaker, Lambda, S3) and container orchestration with Kubernetes.

  • Strong software engineering background with proficiency in Python, Git, and CI/CD workflows. You write robust, testable code.

  • Experience with real-time ML architectures, leveraging tools like Kafka

postings.title: Kotlin Backend Engineer
postings.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. postings.title: Vorstandsreferent:in
postings.description:
Solaris ist Europas führende Plattform für Embedded Finance. Mit der vollständigen deutschen Banklizenz und dem eigenen, modularen B2B-Tech-Stack befähigt Solaris seine Partner – von KMUs bis hin zu großen, multinationalen Nicht-Finanzunternehmen – konforme, kundenorientierte Bankdienstleistungen anzubieten und so nahtlose Erlebnisse für Kunden in allen Branchen zu schaffen. Solaris wurde 2016 gegründet und hat den Banking-as-a-Service-Markt mit einer einmaligen Kombination aus Technologie und Banking als Pionier geprägt. Solaris hat seinen Hauptsitz in Berlin und beschäftigt 300 Mitarbeiter in Europa.

Als Referent:in des Vorstands arbeiten Sie unmittelbar an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Transformation und Umsetzung. Sie unterstützen den Vorstand in der operativen Arbeit bei der Umsetzung der unternehmensweiten AI-Transformation. Sie bereiten Vorstands- und Aufsichtsratsentscheidungen vor, treiben Schlüsselinitiativen über Bereichsgrenzen hinweg und sorgen dafür, dass Entscheidungen konsequent umgesetzt werden.

Die Position ist am Standort Frankfurt am Main angesiedelt, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz am Hauptsitz Berlin sowie bei Kundinnen, Kunden, Investoren und Aufsichtsbehörden.

    • Eigenverantwortliche Strukturierung komplexer strategischer Fragestellungen, von der Hypothese über Analyse bis zur Entscheidungsempfehlung.
    • Steuerung der strategischen Jahresplanung, Objectives and Key Results-Zyklen und Management-Routinen des Vorstands-Büros.
  • AI-Transformation & Digitalisierung

    • Schnittstelle zu Aufsichtsrat, Mehrheitsaktionär (SBI Group) sowie zentralen externen Stakeholdern.
